quest.title: Descending Moon
quest.description: Through the endless, long night, The Doctor's schemes press closer, step by relentless step...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x1000, Mora x44000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

chapter.num: Song of the Welkin Moon: Act VIII
chapter.title: True Moon

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sandrone! How are things going?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Glad you asked. You two are about to become the first people to lay eyes upon my masterpiece... Or should that be the first person and the first, uh... Specter?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Eh, whatever. Come. Feast your eyes on this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, we've never seen something like this before!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It looks impressive!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: This meter displays the progress of my formula. Currently, it's still making the most important connections.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Once it's finished running, I'll deliver it right to your side, and then, we can finally bring Columbina back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do you mean, deliver it? Can't you just tell us over the Dodocommunication Device? It'll just be some numbers, right?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Ugh. You're such a greenhorn. This isn't the kind of formula you solve in math class. It's a highly complex algorithm capable of constructing a framework of rules.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: ...Whatever. We'll be here all day if I start trying to explain it. All you need to know is, the formula must be completed before we can bring Columbina back.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got it.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I'll share the data with you. Nicole's agreed to let me use her information channel, so we just need to use the Dodocommunication Device like so, and...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: There. Now you can check in on my progress.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, look at that! You're amazing, Sandrone!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Pfft, about time you recognized my genius! Took you long enough! Hahaha.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Anyway, that's all from me. You should check on the others if you have time — make sure we don't have any weak links in the chain.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: That might sound harsh to you, but close supervision is a common practice in the Fatui. Not looking to catch anyone out — I just care about everything going smoothly, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I'm kinda stuck here while the formula's running, so I need you to be my second pair of eyes in the meantime.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon. A pleasure to see you both.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Flins! How's everything coming along?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Fairly well, if I do say so myself. Personally, I am ready to confront Dottore head-on.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, you sound much more serious than usual.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: To be honest, I am not usually fond of exercising my full strength. For one thing, it's hardly conducive to maintaining a low profile. Besides, I believe one should have the right to choose when to show their hand.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: I am conserving my strength until the moment of battle is upon us. Anything to boost our chances of victory.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Seeing you get in the zone like this really puts Paimon at ease. Huh, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: I consider it an honor to have your trust.

response.speaker: Flins
response.text: Rest well. I look forward to seeing you both in your element during the battle.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Yes, Miss Moonchanter? What are you staring at?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: You always address me in the strangest ways. "Lady Moonchanter" one minute, "Miss Moonchanter" the next...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Yes, and? Are either of those incorrect?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Not as such. It's just that I simply call you "Nefer" nowadays.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Uh-huh, that's my name. What's your point?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: The point is, I don't add any honorifics or titles.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Meaning what?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: That... maybe we're on friendlier terms now than we used to be.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Is that how you see it? And I thought I was the one with eye damage.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nefer! Lauma!

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: #Paimon. {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just swinging by to check in on you! How are things going? Did you manage to get some rest?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Don't worry about me. I won't slow us down.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: And I give my all to ensure our victory.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. Allow me to give you two a quick checkup...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...All done. You're both in good shape.

choices.text: We're lucky to have your support.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: You're welcome. You'll have your work cut out for you in this battle against Dottore, so make sure to get some rest in first.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon will keep an eye on {M#him}{F#her}, don't you worry!

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: I'm glad to hear it. Take good care of yourself too, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Thankfully, Miss Nicole has come to our aid. Nasha Town is now looking very well defended!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Golden flame... Yes, that's Nicole's power, alright.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Based on the latest message from Grand Master Varka, it sounds like they've reached an agreement.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The situation should be more stable with her assistance. Everyone will have at least some degree of protection.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Albedo, Durin!

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Hello there, you two!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Are you well-rested?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks for your concern. I'm doing alright.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: That's good to hear.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: As per the plan, Albedo and I will be in charge of Nasha Town.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: As Dottore's energy field expands, it's creeping ever closer in that direction... but we will do our best to hold our position.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: We've fought side-by-side many times before, and always with great success.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I believe this time will be no different. So don't worry about us — focus on fighting Dottore.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hostiles incoming... Are these The Doctor's minions?)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Here they come. That's quite a horde.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: As we expected.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Get ready, everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Take your positions and prepare to engage!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Let's begin.

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: I'm at the ready!

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: You're looking well. I trust you've had a good couple of days?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Dottore!

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: It's actually a good thing, in my view. If the subjects of my experiment were to die prematurely, it would throw quite a wrench in the works.

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: And so, I must thank you all for your resilience.

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: We are no longer on the same level, but you are nonetheless worthy of my respect. A creator-god should be merciful and gracious, after all.

dialogues.speaker: The Doctor
dialogues.text: And in any case, it is only right that, before I end your lives, the world is informed of the arrival of their new god.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: I'm aware you've been working on some little tricks to surprise me with, but it appears that none of them have come to fruition.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: My guess would be that you're trying to bring Columbina back. But then, where is Sandrone? Or are you trying to buy time for her?

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: Heh... I always found their friendship to be a curious phenomenon. Two highly incongruent personalities, and yet they share a deep connection.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: Speaking of Columbina, I once saw her as like a younger sister. We got along quite amicably while she was with the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: But then one day, she suddenly decided she would refuse to take part in any further experiments. To this day, I truly don't understand what I could have done to upset her so much.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: It's such a pity. I could have had a sister, a family... But alas, she grew to dislike me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're not fit to be family to her.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: That, I can't deny.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: So many people, all obsessed with playing out the same tired old dramas. This world is rotten to the core.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: And then there's you... You had every opportunity to reach the right conclusion. The thought of killing you off like this... Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: But I maintain that I approached you in good faith. So I will offer you another chance. Will you work with me? You have until I count to ten to make your choice.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: One. Two. Three...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Not in a million years!)

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: Sandrone? What a pleasant surprise. I didn't think you'd join us all the way up here.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: You're as sick and twisted as ever. Don't fool yourself into thinking anyone's grateful for the chances you're offering them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Sandrone? But the formula hasn't finished running yet...)

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: #Funnily enough, I was just discussing a collaboration opportunity with {NICKNAME}. And then I see you... who, I must say, is a good example of an opportunity gone to waste.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Gone to waste?

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: I said that everyone would get one chance. And you've used yours to march right back into the lion's den... So yes, it's an utterly wasted opportunity.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hah! And what makes you think I believe a word that comes out of your mouth?

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: I was planning on disposing of your little formula after wrapping up more urgent business here. But since you've taken the trouble of serving it to me on a silver platter, I can simply bring it forward in the schedule.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: CS

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sandrone...!

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: Now you see how fragile mechanical contraptions are. Just a gentle tap... and they fall to pieces.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: However keen of an inventor Sandrone may have been, her death spells the end of the formula that was running inside her body.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: Of course, I have to commend her for making it this far. As her colleague, I have to admire her stubborn tenacity.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: Now, it is time for you to take your place by my side.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: My count was interrupted, but the second chance I extended to you still stands. Once again — you are welcome to join me.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: By now, I'm sure you have gained a greater appreciation for the power and authority I wield. What is stopping you from embracing a new world of endless possibilities?

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: Not in the mood to talk? As you wish. You seem less talkative than usual today.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: I'll change the topic to something more... apropos. Sandrone was always like this. Never trusting anyone, always so reluctant to share her research with them.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: Objectively speaking, she had her strengths. It is remarkable how she extracted and even optimized the world-formula from so much data.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: But her inability to trust was her undoing. Had she allowed someone else to monitor or run the formula for her, you might still have a chance at victory even now.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: But regrettably, she was a stubborn fool. As much as it pains me, she had to go.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Dottore.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe this is news to you, but people can change. Columbina surprised you when she escaped... And I think Sandrone would surprise you, too.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: Change?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can twist the truth however you want, but I see it, clear as day: You're the one who can't trust other people.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: Is that how you see me?

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: By this point, what can you hope to do about it?

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: My apologies. I had not intended to take your teammates from you.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: But you have a choice in the matter. Obey, and I can release them.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: An excellent deal, if you ask me. Won't you consider it?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Oh... I've been moved inside another space, and it's sealed off.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Looking at the structure of it... It seems like Dottore intends to trap us here.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: There's no exit. Our endurance is about to be put to the test.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Looks like Dottore has opted for a divide and conquer strategy...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: But we will not allow him to triumph.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Now, I shall pray for our victory.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: What's this supposed to be? A knockoff version of the space Columbina got trapped in?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Huh... There really is no way out...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: We'll see about that, Dottore.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I grant you the new moon's blessing.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: The new moon shines upon you.

dialogues.speaker: Il Dottore
dialogues.text: I am growing weary of your stubborn resistance...
